title: Shower Screen Installation quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription: Supply and install a frameless shower screen in an ensuite bathroom in Manly, NSW. This includes one fixed panel (800mm wide x 1950mm high, 10mm clear toughened safety glass) and one pivot door panel (900mm wide x 1950mm high, 10mm clear toughened safety glass). Hardware supplied and installed: two polished chrome wall-to-glass hinges, one polished chrome D-handle (150mm centre-to-centre), and 1.95 linear metres of polished chrome U-channel for the fixed panel. Clear silicone sealant, all necessary fixings, and waterproofing membrane applied to floor-level joints around the screen base.
workingDetail: Toughened safety glass panel(s), Hinges (wall-to-glass or glass-to-glass), Wall channels and U-channels, Handle and towel rail
